## Additional fuel commodities

Commodities beyond GSL/DSL/BIO/ELCPJ that are needed for the full LDV fleet.

```{r new_commodities}
CNG <- newCommodity(
  name = "CNG",
  desc = "Compressed Natural Gas",
  unit = "PJ",
  timeframe = "ANNUAL",
  emis = data.frame(
    comm = "CO2",
    emis = 56.1  # tCO2/PJ, source: IEA/IPCC
  )
)

LPG <- newCommodity(
  name = "LPG",
  desc = "Liquefied Petroleum Gas (Autogas)",
  unit = "PJ",
  timeframe = "ANNUAL",
  emis = data.frame(
    comm = "CO2",
    emis = 63.1  # tCO2/PJ
  )
)

H2 <- newCommodity(
  name = "H2",
  desc = "Hydrogen (compressed, green/blue)",
  unit = "PJ",
  timeframe = "ANNUAL",
  emis = data.frame(
    comm = "CO2",
    emis = 0  # tCO2/PJ, zero-emission at point of use
  )
)
```

## Read vehicle parameters

```{r read_params}
params_df <- read.csv(
  file             = "data/LDV_passenger_params.csv",
  comment.char     = "#",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings       = c("NA", "")
)
# Display the table
knitr::kable(
  params_df[, c("name", "desc", "fuels", "eff_hwy", "eff_cty", "eff_unit",
                "vehicle_cost_usd", "annual_cost_usd", "olife")],
  caption = "LDV Passenger Vehicle Parameters (placeholder values — calibrate from BNVFE)"
)
```

## Build technology objects

```{r build_techs, results='hide'}
# Energy content (MJ/L or MJ/kg) for fuel types used in this fleet.
# CNG and H2 are stored as MJ per "model unit" — here we use MJ/m³ (CNG) and
# MJ/kg (H2) as a proxy for the L/100km → MJ/km conversion when eff_unit="MJ/km".
# For MJ/km entries the fuel_energy vector is not actually needed, but is kept
# for completeness and future L/100km conversions.
ldv_fuel_energy <- c(
  GSL  = 34.2,   # MJ/L LHV
  DSL  = 36.9,
  BIO  = 26.8,   # ethanol/biodiesel average
  LPG  = 26.0,
  CNG  = 35.8,   # MJ/m³ STP (used as proxy)
  H2   = 120.0,  # MJ/kg LHV (hydrogen)
  ELCPJ = NA_real_  # electricity: handled by km/kWh unit, no MJ/L needed
)

# Helper: parse a "|"-delimited fuel string into a character vector
parse_fuels <- function(x) trimws(strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]])

# Build all technologies from the CSV rows
ldv_tech_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(params_df)), function(i) {
  p <- params_df[i, ]

  fuels      <- parse_fuels(p$fuels)
  blend_fuel <- if (!is.na(p$blend_fuel)) p$blend_fuel else NULL

  ideea_vehicle(
    name  = p$name,
    desc  = p$desc,
    fuels = fuels,
    primary_fuel   = p$primary_fuel,
    blend_fuel     = blend_fuel,
    blend_share_up = if (!is.na(p$blend_share_up)) p$blend_share_up else 0.1,

    eff_hwy  = p$eff_hwy,
    eff_cty  = p$eff_cty,
    eff_unit = p$eff_unit,
    fuel_energy = ldv_fuel_energy,

    avg_km_yr      = p$avg_km_yr,
    capacity_units = p$capacity_units,

    load_unit            = "passengers",
    load_per_vehicle_hwy = p$load_per_vehicle_hwy,
    load_per_vehicle_cty = p$load_per_vehicle_cty,
    share_hwy_up = p$share_hwy_up,
    share_cty_up = p$share_cty_up,

    vehicle_cost_usd = p$vehicle_cost_usd,
    annual_cost_usd  = p$annual_cost_usd, 
    olife      = p$olife,
    region     = NA,
    start_year = 2022
  )
})
names(ldv_tech_list) <- params_df$name
```

Number of technologies created: `r length(ldv_tech_list)`.

## Technology diagrams

```{r draw_techs, fig.height=4, fig.width=9, results='asis'}
for (nm in names(ldv_tech_list)) {
  cat("\n\n###", nm, "\n\n")
  draw(ldv_tech_list[[nm]])
}
```

## Fuel efficiency summary

```{r eff_summary, results='asis'}
eff_tables <- lapply(names(ldv_tech_list), function(nm) {
  df <- vehicle_eff_table(ldv_tech_list[[nm]], fuel_energy = ldv_fuel_energy)
  if (!is.null(df)) { df$tech <- nm; df }
})
eff_all <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), eff_tables))

knitr::kable(
  eff_all[, c("tech", "mode", "fuel", "L_per_100km", "km_per_kWh", "MJ_per_km", "mpg_us")],
  digits  = 2,
  caption = "Fuel efficiency summary (all units)"
)
```

## Generate individual PDF reports

Reports are written to `reports/LDV/`. Each report is one page (PDF).

```{r generate_reports, results='asis'}
dir.create("reports/LDV", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  p   <- params_df[i, ]
  nm  <- p$name
  tch <- ldv_tech_list[[nm]]

  img <- if (!is.na(p$image_file) && file.exists(p$image_file)) p$image_file else NULL
  out <- file.path("reports/LDV", paste0(nm, ".pdf"))

  tryCatch({
    ideea_report(
      object     = tch,
      type       = "vehicle",
      image_file = img,
      file       = out, 
      fuel_energy = ldv_fuel_energy
    )
    cat("- **", nm, "** → `", out, "`\n", sep = "")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("- **", nm, "** — ERROR:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
  })
}
```
